text:
Don’t leave without re entry visa, and absolutely don’t trust a clerk who will not be there when you’ll try to come back without.
At the beginning of our process I was told the same thing when my husband (then only my bf) needed to leave for his mom death. He was only allowed to come back more than a year after until they processed our file and gave him an invite to return even though we got married during this time …. (It was Covid time so the process took longer than usual but still, he was not allowed back until he was officially invited by MH) didn’t help to point out their instructions and guidance, they didn’t give a 💩
